title: Send Action Goal
text: Send action goal messages to ROS 2 network, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Source} sets Source for specifying action name Select from ROS network; {Name} sets the rOS 2 action name, {Type} sets the rOS 2 action type, {Paired Monitor Action Goal Block} sets the path to paired Monitor Action Goal block block, {Show ErrorCode output port} enables error code output port, {History} sets the mode of storing goal requests in the queue Keep, {Depth} sets the size of the goal request queue, {Reliability} sets the delivery guarantee of goal requests, {Durability} sets the persistence of action goal requests, {Deadline} sets the maximum amount of time allowed between receiving a goal request and sending goal result, {Lifespan} sets the length of time a goal request is considered valid, {Liveliness} and {Lease Duration} sets the maximum amount of time before an action client has to assert liveliness. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Goal
ports.summary: ROS 2 action goal message input non-virtual bus

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Boolean value to send action goal if there is no goal running true | false

ports.name: UUID
ports.summary: Unique ID dedicated to any goal message non-virtual bus

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error conditions for send action goal request integer

params.name: Source
params.values: Source for specifying action name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.name: Paired Monitor Action Goal Block
params.values: Path to paired Monitor Action Goal block block path

params.name: Show ErrorCode output port
params.values: Enable error code output port off (default) | on

params.name: History
params.values: Mode of storing goal requests in the queue Keep last (default) | Keep all

params.name: Depth
params.values: Size of the goal request queue 1 (default) | non-negative scalar integer

params.name: Reliability
params.values: Delivery guarantee of goal requests Reliable (default) | Best effort

params.name: Durability
params.values: Persistence of action goal requests Volatile (default) | Transient local

params.name: Deadline
params.values: Maximum amount of time allowed between receiving a goal request and sending goal result Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lifespan
params.values: Length of time a goal request is considered valid Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Liveliness
params.values: Liveliness check of action server by action client automatic (default)

params.name: Lease Duration
params.values: Maximum amount of time before an action client has to assert liveliness Inf (default) | positive scalar
